question: How did Śivā, delighting in dice-play, seize her own sovereignty?
premises: Śivā is the agent of the action.
Śivā took away her own sovereignty.
inference: Śivā's delight in dice-play accompanies her seizure of her own sovereignty.
uncertainties: Whether svasāmrājyaṃ implies reclaiming or establishing sovereignty is context-dependent.
plain_english: Delighting in dice-play, the auspicious Śivā seized her own sovereignty.
